note: Reproduced on a migrated repo first: Store.commit_project_changes raised CalledProcessError ("paths are ignored by one of your .gitignore files: .project") and push_project_changes pushed main. Fix in store.py: add/diff/commit/rev-parse run with cwd=self.project_dir and pathspec ".", so the commit lands on whichever branch owns the store; result gains on_branch. push resolves the branch inside the store and pushes it via worktree.push_branch from the root. Plain-directory output is byte-identical (files_changed still ".project/..."; pinned by test_commit_scope, test_auto_commit_messages, test_no_auto_push which all pass). New tests: TestNonHubCommit (9), TestNonHubCommitPlainDirectoryUnchanged (2), TestNonHubPush (8) incl. detached store HEAD, detached main not blocking, relative remote URL.
